items: enclosed 3D printer with automatic filament switching unit (combo SKU)
why: ChatGPT's answer treats this as choosing one printer and only warns the shopper to pick the Combo configuration with its filament feeder. Those Combo SKUs (P1S Combo, P2S Combo, K2 Pro Combo, H2D AMS Combo) are sold and carded as single products, so the multi-filament feeder is part of one product rather than a separate set to assemble.
